Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        wb.EnableConnections: v = "done"
    Case 1
        v = TypeName(wb.EnableConnections)
    Case 2
        wb.ConvertComments: v = "done"
    Case 3
        v = CStr(wb.CanCheckIn)
    Case 4
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c4.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        v = CStr(wb.CanCheckIn)
    Case 5
        v = CStr(wb.ExclusiveAccess)
    Case 6
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c6.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        v = CStr(wb.ExclusiveAccess)
    Case 7
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c7.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.EnableConnections: v = "done"
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & v
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
